jordan: Heads-up — deploying release/infra v3.8.2 to prod tonight at 02:00 UTC. Expected risk: minor background reindex job (non-blocking), cache warmup. Freeze window 01:45-03:30 UTC. I'll be primary rollout watcher. @priya can you be backup? :eyes:

priya: I can cover backup. I'll be on from 01:30-04:00 UTC. What smoke tests should I run?

jordan: Quick smoke list: 1) /health 2) sample chat generation (p99 latency) 3) embeddings sanity. Pasted curl snippets below.

jordan: ```
# health check
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.ai/health
# sample generation
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}'
```

sasha: noted. Any migrations that need explicit rollback steps? :thinking:

devon: No DB schema changes. The reindex runs as a background job; rollback is: stop the job + restore index from snapshot. I've added the exact commands to the runbook (see runbook link in release notes). Rollback ETA ~15m.

jordan: Rollback commands for quick reference: `stop-reindex --job reindex-small-table` and `restore-index --from snapshot-2026-03-17`.

devon: I'll own rollback if needed and monitor reindex progress. Paging rule for this deploy: if p99 gen latency > 2x baseline for >5m OR error rate > 1%, escalate to eng-sre.

oncall-bot: Scheduled deploy job 1899999999-3 created by @jordan for 02:00 UTC. Watchers: jordan, priya. Reminder set for 01:50 UTC.

sasha: Quick Q — will Dedicated customers see any CPU spike? We should notify sales if customers might need capacity adjustments.

jordan: Expected impact is minimal. Autoscaling should absorb traffic. If we observe >5% sustained CPU bump on Dedicated pods, I'll notify sales and prod-ops.

priya: I'll run the smoke list at 02:05 and post results here. If anything looks off I'll escalate to @devon and ping eng-sre.

jordan: Thanks — appreciate it. Ping this thread for any rollout anomalies. :rocket:
